answered.question: What live poker tournaments are upcoming after today (Nov 16, 2026)?
answered.answer: Confirmed on official pages: The Venetian's DeepStack Extravaganza IV (Nov 16–Dec 23, 2026); Wynn's WPT World Championship (Nov 27–Dec 21, 2026); The Venetian's DeepStack Extravaganza NYE (Dec 24, 2026–Jan 10, 2027; headlines only); Wynn Signature Series (Jan 11–24, 2027); The Venetian's DeepStack Showdown (Jan 11–Feb 14, 2027; partly captured).
answered.confidence: High for dates on the listed schedules; partial for NYE and DSS.

answered.question: Is the 2026 WSOP still upcoming?
answered.answer: No. WSOP.com lists the 2026 WSOP at May 26–July 15, 2026, so it has ended.

answered.question: Can someone start tournaments at 8 AM?
answered.answer: Not on any verified schedule. The earliest verified start is 10:10 AM (Venetian RaceDay and Event 56). Most events start at 11:00 AM or 11:10 AM.

answered.question: Which listed events are multi-entry (re-entry, rebuy) or spend-for-chips?
answered.answer: Bellagio weekly events (re-entry through Level 8; optional gratuity adds chips). Wynn daily Friday NLH Rebuy. The Venetian Event 35 is a two-player team event. These are in the excluded section.
answered.confidence: High for Bellagio structures; medium for the Wynn poster (undated)

answered.question: Which Venetian events have a confirmed single-entry structure?
answered.answer: Event 7 ($400, $75K guarantee), Events 14, 28 and 63 ($600, $30K, $40K and $30K guarantees). Structure sheets list no re-entry or add-on. Rows are marked 'structure' in the data.

answered.question: What is the resort fee at Wynn?
answered.answer: $55 plus tax per room night on two official terms pages. A third official terms page says $50 plus tax. Conflict flagged; the current amount needs confirmation at booking.

answered.question: Are Venetian and Wynn walking-distance neighbors?
answered.answer: Both are on the Strip. Both poker rooms are inside their resorts (Venetian: The Palazzo; Wynn: WPT registration on the Wynn poker page). Walking time is not verified.
answered.confidence: High for locations; not verified for time
